applicability: Checking where load acts inside a finite static foot or pad
Calibrating impulse-weighted CoP instrumentation before articulated stance work
claim: For the exact L1.4 free 2 kg pad with a 0.30 x 0.20 m footprint at seven preregistered internal load locations in independent worlds at 60 Hz, the impulse-weighted center of pressure moves strictly monotonically with the authored load location, mirrors for equal-magnitude edgeward loads, stays centered for the centered load, and tracks the projected center of mass with a worst mean error of 4.94 mm against the 6 mm gate while total predicted normal load balances measured gravity within 0.212 N against the 0.25 N gate.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the L1.0-L1.7 contact-engine observations named by the exact source-pinned programs. L1.8 and the knowledge guard are supplementary constraints. It establishes no articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, walking, accepted knowledge, automatic creature guidance, or per-foot allocation of reconstructed whole-system load.

programs.claim_scope: The finite pad's static center-of-pressure estimate tracks declared internal load offsets.

failure_boundaries: Does not provide a generalized continuous foot-force sensor
Does not cover dynamic center-of-pressure motion, rocking, or impacts
Does not cover articulated or compliant feet, toes, or actuated load redirection
Does not establish standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, or walking
mechanism: In static equilibrium the center of pressure must lie below the projected center of mass and the total normal load must equal mg. The observer weights raw Jolt contact points by predicted normal impulse; that predicted impulse is a step-average solver estimate, so the result is a calibrated predicted-impulse CoP, not an exact continuous force transducer.

parameter_effects.change: move across the preregistered [-0.12, 0.12] m grid
hinges_on: The pad staying planted, untilted, and slip-free through every trial
The raw contact manifold spanning the authored footprint
parameter_effects.mechanism: Static equilibrium places the CoP under the projected COM, so the measured CoP follows the authored internal load monotonically and mirrors by sign

scope: One unjointed free 2 kg rigid pad, 0.30 x 0.08 x 0.20 m, on a flat static floor with friction 1.0, custom internal COM offsets in [-0.12, 0.12] m along x only, no clamp, rail, rotation lock, damping, or controller, 60 Hz Jolt physics, Godot 4.7, full_contacts_v2 raw-point observer.
title: Impulse-weighted CoP on a static 0.30 x 0.20 m pad tracks the projected COM within 4.94 mm
unknowns: How the CoP error envelope changes under dynamic loading or rocking
Whether the calibration holds for other footprint shapes and masses
How multiple same-body contact shapes change raw impulse interpretation, measured separately by L1.8
